test_CaptureStdout: test capturing stdout output from print statements using the CaptureStdout context manager
test_CaptureLogger: test capturing logging output from a transformers logger using the CaptureLogger context manager
test_TemporaryHubRepo: test creating and automatically deleting a temporary HuggingFace Hub repository using TemporaryHubRepo context manager
test_TestCasePlus: test using TestCasePlus to access resolved repository paths and auto-removable temporary directories
test_is_flaky: test retrying a flaky test function up to a specified number of attempts on failure with is_flaky decorator
test_slow_decorator: test marking a test function as slow so it is skipped by default unless RUN_SLOW environment variable is set
test_require_torch: test skipping a test function when PyTorch is not installed using the require_torch decorator
test_LoggingLevel: test temporarily changing transformers logging verbosity to INFO and restoring it afterward with LoggingLevel context manager
test_ExtendSysPath: test temporarily adding a directory to sys.path for importing modules using ExtendSysPath context manager
test_nested_simplify: test simplifying nested Python objects by rounding floats and downcasting tensors for equality comparisons
